content.title: How to watch Knicks vs. Pacers: TV channel and streaming options for March 13
content.text: The Indiana Pacers (15-51) hope to stop an 11-game losing streak when they host the New York Knicks (42-25) on March 13, 2026 at Gainbridge Fieldhouse.
